head: Learn AI app for beginners: So That's AI explains it in 134 lessons
dek: So That's AI, out since 24 November for iPhone and iPad, is an illustrated beginner's guide to artificial intelligence in 13 chapters and 134 lessons. It costs $4.99.
details: The lessons cover AI models, platforms and terms, with comparisons and simple drawings, and a glossary of 185 terms. You can search, bookmark lessons and read offline. The maker is LaShanda Hunt; on 25 November it was #40 among paid Education apps on the US App Store.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), $4.99, out since 24 November
means: If AI terms like models and platforms confuse you, this is a self-paced course you can read on your phone, also without internet.
todo: Read the App Store listing and screenshots before buying; there's no free trial mentioned.
